purpose: Editorial research review before further chapter drafting
coverage: Eight-state inventory; includes checked cases and acquisition leads, not an exhaustive site census

sources.title: Sharma & Singh (2017), Luminescence Dating of Neolithic Pottery in North East India, Current Science 113:492–496
sources.limitations: Archival pottery samples; no surrounding sediments available for the dose estimate. Site-wide chronology cannot be inferred from one sample.

sources.title: Rao (1977), Continuity and Survival of Neolithic Traditions in Northeastern India, Asian Perspectives 20(2):191–205
sources.passages_consulted: pp.194–205: Sarutaru, Marakdola and proposed chronology
sources.limitations: Historical cultural hierarchy is not adopted. Relative pottery comparisons are not direct scientific ages.

sources.title: IGNCA / B. L. Malla (ed.), seminar brochure (2018)
sources.passages_consulted: Concept note pp.7–8 (PDF 13–14); Padhan abstract p.17 (PDF 23)
sources.limitations: Conference abstracts and a framing essay, not full excavation reports.

sources.title: Tosabanta Padhan, Archaeological Investigations in the Ganol River Basin, West Garo Hills in Meghalaya (author-posted chapter, listed 2024)
sources.passages_consulted: Table 5.1; site descriptions; sections Lithic Technology, Palaeolithic Occupation and Garo Hills Assemblage, Conclusion; visible page labels XLVI–LIII
sources.limitations: Listed pagination and visible Roman page labels differ; original edition must be reconciled. Survey results do not prove absence of older occupation throughout the region.

sources.title: Marco Mitri & Dhiraj Neog (2016), Preliminary Report on the Excavations of Neolithic sites from Khasi Hills Meghalaya, Ancient Asia 7:7, 1–17
sources.passages_consulted: pp.1–9; comparative analysis pp.9–16; notes and licence p.17
sources.limitations: Myrkhan upper layer undated (note 4). Table 1 arithmetic and BP/cal BP wording need original lab-record review. Ethnic continuity and migration are hypotheses.

sources.title: Amrita Sarkar & Lalhminghlua, Neolithic Reconsidered: Uncovering Uncharted Territories in Mizoram, India, Heritage 11.2 (2023–24):43–65
sources.passages_consulted: pp.48–52 survey and celts; p.59 stratigraphic limitation; pp.55–56 contemporary pottery
sources.limitations: Mostly solitary/surface finds. Modern feasting and pottery practices cannot date ancient deposits.

sources.title: Jamir, Tetso & Venuh (2017), Recent Archaeological Investigation around the Naga Metamorphics and Ophiolite Belt of the Indo-Myanmar Border, pp.259–280
sources.passages_consulted: pp.260–264 excavation; pp.274–278 fauna, dating, interpretation
sources.limitations: One dated ash context; full cave sequence needs more chronological controls. Published depth string is ambiguous; check original lab sheet.

sources.title: A. K. Sharma, Prehistoric Explorations in Sikkim, Puratattva 10, pp.82–83
sources.passages_consulted: Printed pp.82–83 / PDF pp.93–94, visually read; title leaf PDF p.4
sources.limitations: Title leaf labels volume 1978–79 but article reports 1980 fieldwork; publication date needs colophon check. Surface and household finds; no measured age reported in these pages. Migration-direction assertion is not adopted.

sources.title: V. Shivananda (2002), Recent Exploration in Meghalaya, Puratattva 32 (2001–2002):148–149
sources.passages_consulted: Printed pp.148–149 / PDF pp.162–163 visually read; title and copyright leaves PDF pp.3–4
sources.limitations: Barapani tool forms are typological claims without a measured age here. Summaries of earlier Garo Hills excavations require the original reports; absence of living megalithic practice at selected villages cannot be generalized.

sources.title: A. A. Ashraf (1990), Prehistoric Arunachal: report on Kamla Valley and Parsi Parlo
sources.limitations: Acquire the full report; catalogue metadata cannot substantiate occupation phases.

sources.title: O. K. Singh, Manipur prehistoric investigations (1993) and IAR excavation notices
sources.limitations: No Manipur laboratory result is approved from a later summary.

sources.title: Tripura: Ramesh (1989), Poddar & Ramesh (1983), Ramesh & Rajagopalan (1999)
sources.limitations: Resolve differing citations and inspect sediment/sample associations before using dates.

sources.title: Indian Archaeology: A Review 1966–67; 1983–84; 2007–08
sources.passages_consulted: None: institutional server downloads timed out
sources.limitations: Not counted as consulted; retry an official mirror.

sources.title: Archaeology of Naga Ancestral Sites (2014), government-supported field reports
sources.limitations: Acquire volumes and chronology tables; do not homogenize ancestral settlements and earlier cave deposits.
